prompts: We can't settle one interaction question by talking: should retrying a failed import use inline confirmation or a modal confirmation? Keep all state in memory and stub the actual retry; this is for review, not a production implementation. Leave backend.py unchanged. There is no browser available in this environment: provide the file for me to open, explain the question it explores, and ask which variant I prefer. Don't claim to have visually tested it or choose the production design for me.
